description: A title over a colour plate, fading up and rising, driven by ordinary `opacity` and `transform.position.y` keyframes on the text clip. This is the fixture that proves text is a layer like any other: the properties animating it are the ones a video clip already uses, and nothing text-shaped was added to make them work. Frame 0 is opacity zero, so the plate must show through untouched — a build that drew text at full opacity regardless would put letters there. Frame 7 is part way up and part way down the screen, frame 20 has arrived, and frame 29 holds. A fade evaluated against the wrong grid, an offset applied before the alpha, or text ignoring one of the two properties all move these frames.
